breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science Term-II (English) — Civics Unit 1: National Symbols — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Natural National Symbols: Lotus-1950; Banyan tree-1950; Mango-1950; Peacock-1963; Tiger-1973; River Ganges-2008; Elephant-2010; River Dolphin-2010.

en.q: The tiger was adopted as the National Animal in the year ______.
en.explanation: Lotus, banyan tree and mango - 1950; peacock - 1963; tiger - 1973; river Ganges - 2008; elephant and river dolphin - 2010.

questions.quote: River Dolphin: It is the reliable indicator of the health of the entire river eco-system. It is in the endangered list. Elephant: plays a critical role in maintaining the region's forests.

en.q: The reliable indicator of the health of the entire river ecosystem, adopted as a national symbol in 2010, is the ______.
en.explanation: The river dolphin of the Ganges is endangered.

ta.q: முழு ஆற்றுச் சூழல் மண்டலத்தின் நலத்தை அறிய நம்பகமான குறியீடாக உள்ளது ______.

questions.quote: Tamil Nadu's Natural Symbols: Animal - Nilgiri Tahr; Bird - Emerald dove; Flower - Gloriosa Superba; Tree - Palmyrah tree.

en.q: The State animal of Tamil Nadu is the ______.
en.explanation: Bird - Emerald dove; flower - Gloriosa superba (Kandhal); tree - Palmyrah.

ta.explanation: பறவை - மரகதப் புறா; மலர் - செங்காந்தள்; மரம் - பனை.

questions.quote: The tricolour flag is our National flag. The saffron at the top represents valour and sacrifice. The green at the bottom represents fertility and prosperity. The white band in between represents honesty peace and purity. The Ashoka chakra in navy blue represents truth and peace. Our National Flag's length and width proportion is 3:2.

en.q: In the National Flag, the green band at the bottom represents ______.
en.explanation: The saffron band at the top stands for valour and sacrifice.

ta.q: தேசியக் கொடியின் கீழ்ப்பகுதியிலுள்ள பச்சை நிறம் ______ ஐக் குறிக்கிறது.
ta.explanation: மேலுள்ள காவி நிறம் வீரத்தையும் தியாகத்தையும் குறிக்கிறது.

questions.quote: Kodi Kaatha Kumaran (Tirupur Kumaran) was born in Chennimalai of Erode district. In 1932, when Gandhiji was arrested, he took active part in the protests. He held on to the tricolor flag even when he died.

en.q: Tirupur Kumaran, honoured as 'Kodi Kaatha Kumaran', held on to the tricolour flag even when he died in the protests of the year ______.
en.explanation: He was born in Chennimalai, Erode district; a postal stamp was released on his centenary year.

ta.q: 'கொடி காத்த குமரன்' என்று போற்றப்படும் திருப்பூர் குமரன், தேசியக் கொடியைக் கீழே விடாமல் உயிர்நீத்த போராட்ட ஆண்டு ______.

questions.quote: The National flag was designed by Pingali Venkayya from Andhra Pradesh. The first Indian Flag was woven at Gudiyatham in Vellore district of Tamilnadu. This flag was hoisted by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru on 15th August 1947 at Red Fort (Delhi).

en.q: After Independence, Jawaharlal Nehru hoisted the National Flag on 16 August 1947 at the ______.
en.explanation: According to the textbook the flag was woven at Gudiyatham.

ta.q: சுதந்திரத்துக்குப் பின் ஜவஹர்லால் நேரு 1947 ஆகஸ்ட் 16 அன்று தேசியக் கொடியை ஏற்றிய இடம் ______.

questions.quote: The upper part has four lions facing North, South, East and West. One can only see three lions at a time. The lower part has an elephant (energy), a horse (speed), a bull (hardwork) and a lion (majestic). 'Satyameva Jayate' has been inscribed at its bottom.

en.q: How many lions of the National Emblem can be seen at a time?
en.explanation: The upper part has four lions facing the four directions; one can see only three at a time. 'Satyameva Jayate' means 'Truth alone triumphs'.

ta.q: தேசியச் சின்னத்தில் ஒரே நேரத்தில் எத்தனை சிங்கங்களைக் காண முடியும்?
ta.explanation: நான்கு திசைகளை நோக்கிய நான்கு சிங்கங்களில் மூன்றை மட்டுமே காண முடியும். 'வாய்மையே வெல்லும்' கீழே பொறிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

questions.quote: The national emblem was accepted on 26th January 1950. This emblem is found at the top of the government communication, Indian currency and passport.

en.q: The National Emblem was accepted on ______.
en.explanation: It appears on government communications, Indian currency and the passport.

ta.explanation: அரசுத் தகவல் தொடர்பு, நாணயம், கடவுச்சீட்டு ஆகியவற்றில் இச்சின்னம் உண்டு.

questions.quote: 'Jana Gana Mana' is our National anthem. It symbolises the sovereignty and integrity of our nation. This anthem was written by Rabindranath Tagore in Bengali. This was transcripted in Hindi and was accepted by the Constituent Assembly on 24th January 1950.

en.q: 'Jana Gana Mana' was originally written in ______.
en.explanation: It was transcripted in Hindi and accepted by the Constituent Assembly on 24 January 1950.

ta.explanation: இது இந்தியில் மொழிபெயர்க்கப்பட்டு 1950 ஜனவரி 24 அன்று ஏற்கப்பட்டது.

questions.quote: National Micro organism: The curd which we consume every day is curdled from milk by a micro organism called lacto bacillus delbrueckii. This was accepted as our national micro organism in the year 2012.

en.q: The national micro-organism that curdles milk into curd was accepted in the year ______.

ta.q: பாலைத் தயிராக்கும் தேசிய நுண்ணுயிரி ஏற்கப்பட்ட ஆண்டு ______.

questions.quote: Currency of India: The currency released by Sher Shah Sur in the sixteenth century was 'Rupiya'. The symbol of rupees was designed by D. Udhayakumar from Tamil Nadu in the year 2010.

en.q: The currency 'Rupiya', from which the word 'rupee' evolved, was released by ______.
en.explanation: The rupee symbol was designed in 2010 by D. Udhayakumar of Tamil Nadu.

questions.quote: National Calender: During the reign of Emperor Kanishka he began following a new calendar in the year 78 CE/AD. The year begins from the spring equinox which falls on March 22nd. The famous astronomer Meghnad Saha headed the Calendar Reformation Committee on 22nd March 1957.

en.q: Who headed the Calendar Reform Committee (set up in 1952) whose calendar was adopted as the national calendar in 1957?
en.explanation: The Saka calendar year begins from the spring equinox on 22 March (21 March in a leap year).

ta.q: 1952இல் அமைக்கப்பட்டு, 1957இல் தேசிய நாட்காட்டியாக ஏற்கப்பட்ட நாட்காட்டியை உருவாக்கிய நாட்காட்டி சீர்திருத்தக் குழுவுக்குத் தலைமை தாங்கியவர் ______.
ta.explanation: சக ஆண்டு வசந்த கால சம இரவுநாளான மார்ச் 22இல் தொடங்கும்.

questions.quote: Independence Day: Every year, August 15 is celebrated to commemorate India's freedom from British rule. The Prime Minister unfurls the National Flag on the Independence Day at the Red Fort, New Delhi.

en.q: Independence Day is celebrated every year on ______.
en.explanation: The Prime Minister unfurls the flag at the Red Fort.

questions.quote: Gandhi Jayanthi: The birthday of Mahatma Gandhi, the Father of our Nation, was declared one of the National festivals. It falls on 2nd October. In 2007, the United Nations declared October 2nd as the 'International Day of Non-violence'.

en.explanation: The UN declared it the International Day of Non-violence in 2007.

ta.explanation: 2007இல் ஐ.நா. இதைச் சர்வதேச அகிம்சை நாளாக அறிவித்தது.
